residents.name: Mara
residents.friendlyLine: Mara saves you a seat by the board. 'The wardens ask after you.'
residents.hostileLine: Mara blocks the doorway. 'The company has nothing for you. Move on.'

residents.name: Bren
residents.concern: The school stove and council fittings
residents.friendlyLine: Bren sets aside a stool and wipes the anvil. 'Good to see you.'
residents.hostileLine: Bren keeps his hands on the anvil. 'I have work to finish. Speak elsewhere.'

residents.name: Lysa
residents.friendlyLine: Lysa wraps a warm loaf and presses it into your hands. 'For the road.'
residents.hostileLine: Lysa turns the bread board away. 'The oven is full. Try again another day.'

residents.name: Iven
residents.friendlyLine: Iven clears a shelf for your notes. 'The archive remembers its friends.'
residents.hostileLine: Iven closes the ledger. 'The reading room is closed to you.'

residents.name: Sella
residents.friendlyLine: Sella labels a stool at the lesson bench. 'Sit in. You have earned it.'
residents.hostileLine: Sella corks the remedy jars. 'I cannot teach someone the city no longer trusts.'

residents.name: Perrin
residents.concern: Lamp glass for stalls or courtyard
residents.friendlyLine: Perrin holds up a lamp. 'I saved you the clear glass. Come see.'
residents.hostileLine: Perrin shields the lamp with one hand. 'The courtyard is not for you tonight.'

residents.name: Tessa
residents.friendlyLine: Tessa waves you past the queue. 'The good cart just came in.'
residents.hostileLine: Tessa stands in front of the stall. 'I will not have trouble at my counter.'

residents.name: Daro
residents.friendlyLine: Daro sets out two cups. 'You have a good eye. Taste both.'
residents.hostileLine: Daro folds the cloth over the counter. 'I have nothing mixed for you.'

residents.name: Edda
residents.friendlyLine: Edda makes room on the cart bench. 'We saved you a place.'
residents.hostileLine: Edda keeps her hand on the cart ledger. 'The porters voted. You are not on the list.'

residents.name: Oren
residents.friendlyLine: Oren unlocks the record room. 'Your name carries weight here.'
residents.hostileLine: Oren keeps the permit book closed. 'The office has no time for you.'

residents.name: Halwen
residents.friendlyLine: Halwen sets down a finished blade. 'Tell me what you think of the edge.'
residents.hostileLine: Halwen lowers the workshop shutter. 'The forge is closed to you.'

residents.name: Mina
residents.friendlyLine: Mina cuts a handful of herbs. 'Take these. The garden remembers your help.'
residents.hostileLine: Mina keeps the garden gate latched. 'The beds are spoken for.'

residents.name: Nella
residents.friendlyLine: Nella leaves the ferry chain loose. 'Cross whenever you need.'
residents.hostileLine: Nella blocks the ferry steps. 'Find another crossing.'

residents.name: Corin
residents.concern: Credit for a visiting cook's recipe
residents.friendlyLine: Corin slides a plate across the counter. 'I kept this warm for you.'
residents.hostileLine: Corin turns the kitchen light down. 'The inn is full tonight.'

residents.name: Suri
residents.friendlyLine: Suri hands you a lantern frame. 'The children want your opinion.'
residents.hostileLine: Suri gathers the lantern wire. 'The workshop is not open.'
